## 1) AUB module autopilot (select best)

**After it finishes, verify:**

- Whether it wrote/updated a “champion” file (often something like `baseline/champion_*.json`) or updated symlinks like `baseline/champion_v5_latest.json`.
- Whether any candidates failed (stack traces, missing deps). If there are failures, those are inputs for the “next_fix” step later.

## 2) System-level autopilot (system candidates)
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml --run
```
**Purpose:** evaluates end-to-end/system candidates (not just modules) defined in `system_candidates.yaml`.

**After it finishes, verify:**
- Which system candidate is best on your primary metric(s).
- Whether the system autopilot performs promotion automatically or just reports results (depends on your tool).

## 3) Generate “next fix” guidance


**After it finishes, verify:**
- `baseline/reports/next_fix.md` exists and references the most recent run IDs/artifacts.
